faqs.question: How long does a typical AI Agent Development engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most discovery-to-launch cycles run 6–14 weeks depending on tool access, data readiness, and the number of agent workflows. Ongoing optimization then improves accuracy and automation coverage month over month.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plug into your CRM, helpdesk, knowledge bases, and internal APIs, and we collaborate with your product, ops, and engineering stakeholders rather than replacing them.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: We define KPIs at kickoff — task completion rate, handle-time reduction, deflection, conversion lift, or cost per resolved request — and report against them with clear baselines.

faqs.question: What kind of AI agents do you build?
faqs.answer: We build task-focused agents for research, lead qualification, support triage, internal ops, and multi-step workflows — grounded in your data and tools, not generic chat demos.

faqs.question: Do agents need clean data before we start?
faqs.answer: Helpful, but not a blocker. Discovery maps data gaps early; we often start with a high-ROI workflow while improving knowledge sources and permissions in parallel.

faqs.question: How do you keep agents accurate and safe?
faqs.answer: We use grounded retrieval, tool allowlists, human-in-the-loop checkpoints for sensitive actions, evaluation sets, and monitoring so drift and hallucinations are caught early.

faqs.question: Can agents hand off to humans?
faqs.answer: Yes. Escalation rules, transcript context, and CRM/helpdesk tickets are part of the design so agents assist your team instead of trapping customers in loops.

faqs.question: What do we get at launch?
faqs.answer: A production agent workflow, admin/runbooks, evaluation baselines, analytics hooks, and a 30-day optimization plan focused on the KPIs we agreed on.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share your use case on WhatsApp or the contact form. We run a discovery call, propose a scoped pilot, and confirm timeline, owners, and success metrics before build starts.

faqs.question: Who works on the engagement?
faqs.answer: A solution lead, AI/automation engineer, and integration specialist — with design or marketing partners when the agent touches customer-facing journeys.
